[[File:Rotkan_visa.jpg|thumb|A Rotkan visa stamp in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] on an Intergalactic Passport]]
'''Rotkan''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] location where the [[Euclidean Complex]] was located. Visitors had to have visas stamped on their [[Intergalactic Passport]]s in order to enter Rotkan and were to be accompanied by guides at all times. Rotkan was known to have used another calendar system other than the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] at some point.
